text:
maya: Heads-up — canary for sparrow-mini-v2-int8 is showing a subtle but reproducible funcall output missing the top-level "action" key about 2.1% of the time. Caught in the structured-output samplers. Repro steps and sample below.

ash: Ugh. sample?

maya: Sample payload (from canary run #47):
```json
{
  "request_id": "c47-01",
  "tool_calls": [
    {"name": "lookup_price", "args": {"item": "widget"}}
  ],
  "result": {"price": 19.95}
}
```
Note the tool_calls are there but top-level "action" (enum expected by call adapter) is absent. Parser treats as fallback narration and we end up with no-op.

ben: Do we see any pattern — length, batch, kv-cache?

maya: Initial correlates:
- appears more in int8 mirrored canaries than fp16 mirrors
- higher for requests with streaming enabled
- often when prompt includes a trailing code block or JSON example

infra-bot: Mirroring stats for sparrow-mini-v2-int8 canary: 47 runs, 1000 total requests, 21 missing-action events (2.1%). Mirror cohort (fp16) shows 0.2%. Detailed log: https://redwood.internal/canary/1795012345

leo: Possibly a tokenization/truncation artifact where the model emits a closing bracket but drops the label before EOS? Could be attention kernel quant noise.

ash: Can we repro locally with the same request and seed? If deterministic, we can bisect quant kernel.

maya: Tried seed=42 deterministic mirror run, reproduced 4/200. Repro isn't 100% but consistent. I dumped raw tokens for the failures — they end with a short punctuation sequence then stop.

ben: Two-prong plan: 1) quick patch on call adapter to tolerate missing-action by inferring from tool_calls when present as a stopgap; 2) deeper bisect on runtime quant kernels and streaming chunking.

leo: Agree. For (1) we should add a soft-accept rule: if top-level action missing and tool_calls array exists and non-empty, treat as action: "invoke_tool" and attach heuristic reviver. Add metric so we can A/B it.

maya: I'm on the patch. Rolling to canary now with metric tag `heuristic_reviver=v1`. Will monitor for correctness/regressions.

infra-bot: Deploy triggered: canary-reviver-v1 -> 3 nodes. Canary ID c47-rev1.

ben: For the bisect: @leo you ok owning kernel regression bisection? Suggest comparing int8 kernels (q8a, q4 variants) and streaming framing changes. Use the sample set in /datasets/struct-output-edgecases.

leo: On it. I'll run cross-kernel mirrors and a small warmup to check KV cache alignment. ETA EOD.

maya: Also adding an eval that forces a few prompt suffix shapes (trailing triple-backtick, nested arrays, long prefix) into the continuous regression harness. We should measure funcall-acceptance rate and fidelity delta vs fp16 baseline.

ash: Nice. Also file an infra ticket for retaining raw-token dumps for 24h when structured parse fails so we can triage without re-run.

maya: Filed INF-8472.

ben: Cool. If the reviver patch increases false positives we can gate by rollout percent. Keep logs minimal but include sample diffing.

maya: Will post initial canary metrics in this thread once 10k more requests processed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
